cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women scheduled for elective lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Prophylactic phenylephrine infusion significantly improved hemodynamic stability and reduced the incidence of oxytocin-induced hypotension, nausea, vomiting, and the need for rescue vasopressors during caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
